package.name: parol6_bringup
package.description: Minimal (no MoveIt) ros2_control bringup for the PAROL6 arm: URDF + ros2_control fragment, controller config, and a launch file. Used on machines/distros where MoveIt2 isn't available yet -- see the top-level README for why. For MoveIt-based planning, see parol6_moveit's real_robot.launch.py (from PAROL6-ROS2-MOVEIT) instead.
